name: Standard RL Benchmark Suite
description: Standard RL Benchmark Suite for Theta-IDE: Stable-Baselines3 (PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC), d3rlpy offline baselines (CQL, IQL, TD3+BC), Atari 2600 ALE environments, Gymnasium Classic Control, and standard deep neural network models (DNN, NatureCNN, Dueling ResNet).
